policy.provider_placement: existing native/inline surfaces; task-first fallback remains
policy.precedence: latest user directive, current assigned task, reference documents and prior replies
policy.scope: same task/session/authorized workspace; references do not expand permissions
policy.missing_context: Explicit directives remain usable despite context lookup failure; stored empty differs from unavailable/truncated; never resurrect older body.
policy.completion: perform changes and validation; report actual evidence
policy.host_discovery: Discover repository/project, history/session and account-status capabilities once; empty workdir is not account denial; no credential reads or new cross-principal grants
policy.history_reads: Compact list/search first; up to3 initial threads/concurrent calls; outputs=false/3turns/1500chars when supported; same-request exact-page reuse; returned cursors for older pages; fresh after mutations or account/session changes
policy.freshness: Unversioned provider JSON/HTML and component snapshots are not proof of current Yjs; conflicting alternate representations have unknown chronology and remain references.
policy.context_cli: RIID-5900: only capability/socket/task-bearing launches get snapshot CLI rules. Read context get once, expand supported work leaves only as needed, page by returned cursor, retain snapshot/truncation/status evidence, never claim live/freely searchable context or expose credentials.

limits: Prompt-level read budgets are not an enforced native MCP cache or universal model adherence guarantee
Initial app-server and resumed TUI tool inventories may differ; never infer identical capability from a resumed session
